# Advisories the pip-audit job (.github/workflows/supply-chain.yml) is told to ignore.
#
# One advisory per line: the ID pip-audit prints (PYSEC-..., GHSA-..., CVE-...), whitespace, then `#` and the
# reason it does not apply or cannot be fixed yet, ideally with a date and a way out. The job fails if a line has
# no reason, so an ignore is always a written decision that shows up in review.
#
#   GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx  # 2026-11-20: only reachable through <feature>, which we never call; drop when <pkg> 2.1 ships
#
# Keep this list empty when you can. An ignore is per advisory, never per package.
